mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals economic weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP by more than 1% over two quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP declined by more than 1% over two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals a strengthening economy, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k jobs for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 10% over two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 10% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the federal funds rate is below 1% and the consumer price index increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals a severe economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP growth was negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.
